risk_note: Admin console claim review (apps/admin; attribution is decided only by the server, the page shows its result; codex-run classed it RV2, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Contracts CT-24d / CT-24l (adminListClaims, adminGetClaim, adminApproveClaimItem, adminRejectClaimItem; planned, backend not done, developed against the contract with a fake server); visuals per the finalized spec design/specs/admin-claims.md. List /claims with filters, claim_status tabs and counts, ?status preselect; review page /claims/<id> with the evidence comparison taken only from the server's matched, per-item approve / reject with a 5-200 character note and the six staff reject reasons, single submit, refresh from the returned claim, the auto-attributed hint only for the reviewed item, 20902 refetch with a request token so stale responses never overwrite newer ones; states and 10403. Rule tests by Codex in two calls (a first call stopped on an excerpt error before writing anything was not counted); Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/2: 35 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds; test machine verify-fast/4 and browser/5 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1: review note had no upper bound and was sent past the contract maxLength; S2: a late refresh after 20902 could overwrite a newer review), round 2 pass after the implementation fix

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1: the evidence comparison could pass with a client-side string compare; S1: the auto-attributed hint had no negative assertions; 2 S2), round 2 pass after Codex round 2 (1 S2: the hint must follow only the reviewed item, carried into the implementation constraints)
